title: Build the `app/server/*` adapter layer over `lib/`
statement: Create the adapter modules the shell needs, each beginning with `import 'server-only'` and re-exporting by explicit name or wrapper. Expose only the capabilities the first slice requires. `lib/` itself is not modified and gains no marker, so `bin/` and the test suite keep working under plain Node.
notes: ⚠️ The review-status write is a LOCKING capability and DEC-0021 holds those back for individual review before exposure — so it is deliberately NOT part of this task. It arrives with the review action, where it can be examined on its own. ⚠️ DONE 2026-08-27. Two adapters, a README stating what is deliberately absent, and six static tests — each falsified before being trusted. ⚠️ THE PROBE ROUTES WERE TEMPORARY AND ARE GONE. Verifying that a Server Component can import the adapters needed a route that imports them; verifying the client refusal needed one that violates the rule. Both were built, measured, and deleted, and the tree was rebuilt clean afterwards. Neither reads planning content — REQ-0021 confines reads to the reader, which does not exist until TSK-0005, so even a throwaway route was written to import without reading. ⚠️ `server-only` was added as a dependency. Next.js implements the guard internally and the package's contents are unused, but the specifier must still RESOLVE, so it is a real dependency rather than a documentation flourish.
